package: FE-4 (docs/FRONTEND_PLAN.md): map layout, layers menu and credits; hover card, cursor readout, precise marker clicks and Gaia DR3 stars per view
scope: FE-4a.0: optional ExplorerMap layout prop ('panel' default, unchanged markup; 'fill' for FE-2): the map fills its container, the toolbar (wavelength, AllWISE, sequence footprint, Gaia DR3, Zoom to sequence) moves into a keyboard-accessible floating Layers menu, loading and error messages overlay the map top left, and the legends (SPHEREx sequence grid outline, Gaia DR3 catalog positions predicted for the median frame date and not SPHEREx detections, AllWISE not SPHEREx) stay visible with the credits (static coadd, NASA/SPHEREx Caltech/IPAC, Aladin Lite 3.8.2 GPL-3, ESA/Gaia/DPAC while Gaia is shown) in a bottom-right strip outside the menu; the iframe keeps the same element in both layouts and every existing message to it is unchanged; one new 'layout' message lets sky-map.html hide, in the fill layout only, the Aladin corner controls under those overlays (frame selector and location box, projection button, logo; Aladin Lite stays credited in the strip); the sequence footprint outline changes from the 3D-model violet to the SPHEREx colour; checked in the browser with a temporary harness that was not committed (956x602 container gives a 956x602 iframe, keyboard open/Escape/focus return, closing on a map click, Gaia legend and credit, same iframe element across layout switches, 375x812 phone); new prefixed stylesheet and server-rendered vitest tests of both layouts. FE-4a + FE-4b: sky-map.html registers, after the #114 click handler and without touching the #86 plane code, the only objectHovered, objectHoveredStop, objectClicked, mouseMove, positionChanged and zoomChanged handlers and sends ids and numbers only (hover, hover-end, cursor at most once per animation frame and only without a marker under the cursor, one precise select per marker click with footprints skipped, view debounced 500 ms, escape; mouseleave ends hover and cursor); Gaia markers carry their source id in the Aladin source data and are drawn at 8 px with a hover colour, and a separate catalog draws the five challenge targets (api/showcase.ts presets) as labelled squares; the parent validates every message by type (api/mapHover.ts), drops the generic select that follows a precise one within 300 ms, keeps the Gaia catalog values in memory and draws a React glass card next to the cursor (flipped and clamped inside the map container; pinned on click with a close button and Esc, closed on pan or zoom, following its marker when the map recentres on it) with the Gaia DR3 source id, G and BP-RP, the parallax with its error and a 1/parallax distance only when parallax > 0 and parallax/error > 5 (otherwise 'Parallax too uncertain for a distance'), total proper motion, RV, the prediction date and the footer 'Gaia DR3 catalog - not SPHEREx measurements'; no Teff and no GSP-Phot distance; challenge targets say 'Challenge target' and 'Position predicted for <date> from SIMBAD astrometry - not a SPHEREx detection' (the presets are SIMBAD astrometry propagated to each target's mean SPHEREx date); onSelect gets the marker position (exact stored values) plus optional sourceId, label, layer and insideFieldId (new pointInFootprint in skyFootprint.ts); a bottom-left cursor readout in the fill layout; optional recenterKey and onView props. FE-4b: a 'Gaia DR3 stars' toggle (on in fill, off in panel) queries VizieR CfA I/355/gaiadr3 per settled view of at most 0.5 degree (the plan said 1 degree; timed on 2026-11-15, 1-degree views took 16-18 s next to Barnard's Star against 2.9-4.3 s for 0.5-degree views around the five targets; cone 1.2 x the visible half-diagonal plus a proper-motion margin, -sort=Gmag, at most 500 rows, abort of the previous view, 20-view LRU cache that stores the queried radius and answers any view whose visible half-diagonal it covers, so small pans reuse it), propagates positions to the open sequence median epoch or MJD 61000 and says which date; sequence predictions (#111) win when shown; 'Zoom in to see Gaia stars' above 0.5 degree; a VizieR failure only shows a status note. The VizieR column names were checked against real VizieR CfA asu-tsv responses (Gaia DR3, ESA/Gaia/DPAC) fetched on 2026-11-15 and stored unmodified as test fixtures (api/__fixtures__/*.tsv: bright rows, low parallax significance, negative parallaxes, two-parameter sources and an empty cone around Barnard's Star). Checked in the browser with a temporary harness that was not committed (card about 6 ms after the mouse move, cards inside the 956x602 container in all four corners, precise select equal to the marker position and the generic one dropped, Esc forwarded from the iframe, pinned card closing on drag, mouse leave hiding card and readout, one VizieR request per settled view with the earlier ones aborted, recenterKey) and on the home page panel layout (target hover card, precise select of the Barnard's Star marker, Gaia DR3 stars toggle). Not checked on a touch device. No new external assets Review fixes (same branch): the iframe tracks hovered markers per Aladin object instead of per id, so replacing the Gaia markers under the cursor keeps the card and a zoom over a marker shows it again at the next mouse move (pure createHoverTracker, run from the page source in a test); a light 'move' message closes a pinned card at the start of a pan or zoom and only the debounced 'view' (now with fovX/fovY) queries VizieR; ExplorerMap's message handling is a pure reducer (reduceMapMessage) tested as message sequences; on touch, a generic select (Aladin 3.8.2 fires objectClicked only for taps under 100 ms) snaps to the nearest marker within 15 px; the card is rendered in a portal on body (fixed, still clamped to the map) and the status notes moved under the Layers button, so FE-2's search no longer covers them; Esc closes an open Layers menu before the pinned card; the pinned card is a labelled group announced by a live region and the close button returns focus to the map; a 'Challenge targets' layer toggle and legend (gold squares, SIMBAD positions, not SPHEREx detections, SIMBAD/CDS credit) and target marker ids from showcase.ts fieldId when present; the panel Gaia legend now says 'not SPHEREx detections' and the source cut; a parallax that rounds to zero gets more decimals (-0.004 +- 0.167 mas instead of -0.00). Checked in the browser on a scratch copy of origin/main (FE-2 home, 1366x650) with these files overlaid, not committed: marker replacement under the cursor, zoom over a target, precise target click (exact position in the URL), Esc order, card above the FE-2 search, status notes under Layers, a simulated VizieR failure, a simulated coarse-pointer tap 8 px off a star, cache hit on a 0.1-fov pan. Not checked on a real touch device. Integration with FE-2 after its merge (faricool54 with Claude Code): SkyExplorer passes recenterKey (bumped on every non-map selection, so picking the same target again recentres a panned map); a click on a challenge-target marker opens its saved sequence like its chip (no job) and a click on a Gaia DR3 star labels the dock with its source id; checked in the browser against the local API at 1366x650 (hover card on Barnard with Gaia values and the not-SPHEREx footer, click pins it and opens Time without a job) and 375x812 (no horizontal overflow). FE-4c (faricool54 with Claude Code): optional autoZoomKey on ExplorerMap; the home passes it for picks (target chips, search, shared links) so the map zooms once to the picked sequence's footprint and its Gaia stars appear without opening Layers; map clicks never change the key. Checked in the browser at 1366x650 (RW Aurigae chip: 28'x17' view with the sequence outline and Gaia circles). 2026-11-15 FE-4d (faricool54 with Claude Code): Gaia DR3 stars per view now up to 1.2 degrees, with every source up to 0.5 degree and G < 15 above (VizieR CfA timings in gaiaLayer.ts: a G < 12 tier up to 3 degrees was dropped after review because 1.5-3 degree cones took 24-30 s around RW Aurigae and did not answer next to Barnard's Star; a G limit keeps the stars readable but does not make wide cones fast); the legend names the G limit and a 'Zoom in to see fainter Gaia stars' hint shows; the per-view cache keys on the G limit; the WISE 0855 'VizieR did not answer' failure (a fast 899-byte HTTP 200 answer without the table, twice, after queries for the old view at the new epoch) is handled by waiting for the sequence epoch and 600 ms of settling before querying and by one retry after a fast failure; a click on a Gaia DR3 marker looks up the object card and the 3D tab at the marker's predicted position and epoch with a 1.5 arcsec radius (optional radius_arcsec and epoch_mjd in client.getObjectContext). Checked in headless Chrome against the local API. Review fixes: neutral wide-view failure text (a fast VizieR 'database is not currently reachable' answer is not a timeout); the sequence field fetch gives up after 12 s so the per-view stars still load at the default epoch.
